reports.title: IES Holdings Reports Fiscal 2026 Fourth Quarter and Full Year Results; Board Authorizes Additional $350 Million for Share Repurchase Program

desk.headline: Revenue up 55% to $1.39bn and adjusted EPS $4.07, beat; no numeric outlook, extra $350m buyback
results: Quarterly revenue jumped 55% to $1.39bn and operating income doubled, driven by data-centre work.
For the year, Communications revenue rose 48%, Commercial & Industrial 83% and Infrastructure Solutions 66%.
Residential revenue fell 7% for the year and its profit dropped to $40.1m from $103.8m on weak housing demand.
Bought DBM Global (structural steel) in October, funded partly with $525m of new borrowing; $125m already repaid.
Bought back 350,000 shares after year-end and added $350m to the buyback plan.

guidance.summary: IES gives no numeric guidance. Management expects continued strong organic growth in fiscal 2027 outside Residential.

call.source: No call coverage found — IES did not hold a results call; tone based on the press release
